ladder-and-cone.alt: Left: a 10-foot ladder leans against a wall with its foot 6 feet out and its top 8 feet up, a right triangle with x squared + y squared = 10 squared. Right: a cone-shaped tank, point down, 10 feet tall with top radius 4 feet, holding water of depth h and surface radius r; similar triangles give r over h = 4 over 10.
